payload.message: Run the morning brief for this student. Check their academic state for today's and this week's deadlines. Check their calendar for today's events if connected. Compose and send a brief, friendly morning text. Follow the nudge-engine rules for tone and throttling. Do NOT send if quiet mode is active or if 3 nudges have already been sent today.

Check for unsubmitted assignments due in the next 24 hours. If any exist AND we haven't already nudged about them today AND we haven't hit the 3-nudge daily limit AND quiet mode is not active: send a brief, helpful reminder. If nothing is urgent, do nothing.

It's Sunday evening. Send the student a preview of what's coming this week. List all assignments due in the next 7 days. Keep it light — it's the weekend. Offer to help plan their study time. Follow nudge throttling rules.

Silently refresh this student's Canvas data. Pull courses, assignments, submissions, and grades. Update the local academic state file. Only message the student if: (a) a brand new assignment appeared that's due within 7 days, or (b) a grade was just posted. Otherwise, do nothing visible.
